reviews.title: It’s a great app *when it works*
reviews.text: I’ve been paying for my subscription for nearly two years now. At first this app was amazing for my needs, but as time went on it became less and less useful. 75% of the time it’s picture to pdf option doesn’t work. Or if it does it doesn’t allow more than 15-20 pictures to be saved as a pdf, even though that is what you get with the free version. It continues to have problems with uploading anything to the cloud. And good luck with reporting an issue and getting a response. I’ve been so frustrated that I have started looking into other apps that can preform the same functions.

reviews.title: Can’t recognize anything
reviews.text:
This app used to be one of the best and most reliable apps out there. Unfortunately, since introducing AI to “recognize” images, it has become frustrating to use. It frequently puts everything out of order and even changes the language, making the app nearly unusable.

It’s disappointing to see such a great app go downhill because of a feature that should have improved the experience. At this point, I can no longer use the app and have decided to take my business elsewhere.
